rules.statement: A lessee of one portion cannot claim from the other lessee a right of way by prescription over the other portion, nor is he entitled to claim a way of necessity.
rules.supporting_quote: Therefore, where a land is divided by its owner into two portions and each portion is given on lease to a different person the lessee of one portion cannot claim from the other lessee a right of way by prescription over the other portion. Nor is he entitled to claim a way of necessity.
